Name: JanekFlightTraining
Description: Welcome to Operation Live Fire. You are assigned to the 18th Trellis Wing aboard the CV6-Orion. I am Lt. Mara Venn, your Third Fleet instructor. Begin with space flight, target practice, atmospheric flight and ground strike. As your rank and command skills develop, return for frigate training, advanced destroyer combat and carrier operations. Each lesson shows its prerequisites below.

Name: SolusPatrol
Description: Coordinates orbital patrols and investigates threats to local shipping. Posted to Solus to coordinate Alliance operations with the local authorities.

Name: TelmeraLiaison
Description: Arranges escorts for visiting diplomatic personnel. Posted to Solus to coordinate Alliance operations with the local authorities.

Name: ParagonWatch
Description: Handles patrol and interception assignments for Paragon traffic.

Name: LorisWatch
Description: Issues sector defense assignments from the Loris transfer hub.

Name: JanekTraffic
Description: Clears orbital traffic and coordinates rescue calls near Janek.

Name: JanekMaterials
Description: Coordinates access to refinery logistics and ore convoys.

Name: JanekFleet
Description: Coordinates Third Fleet assignments around Janek aboard Archon. Campaign command officers issue new operations from their assigned origin systems.

Name: JarnellWatch
Description: Monitors merchant arrivals and outer belt traffic.

Name: JarnellEnvoy
Description: Liaises between freight operators and the Alliance authorities.

Name: BorovaPatrol
Description: Keeps watch over the approach to the transfer station.

Name: BorovaCommand
Description: Coordinates senior fleet operations around Borova.

Name: AthenarWatch
Description: Tracks shipping transits and missing merchant reports.

Name: AthenarEnvoy
Description: Handles sensitive civilian movements through Athenar.

Name: ParagonCommand
Description: Directs fleet coordination for the Paragon approaches.

Name: ThraleWatch
Description: Manages convoy traffic above Thrale.

Name: ThraleLiaison
Description: Handles visiting delegations and flight clearances.

Name: SolusEnvoy
Description: Represents the independent authorities in talks with freight operators.

Name: TrellisWatch
Description: Coordinates dock traffic and responds to distress calls near Trellis.

Name: KalonLiaison
Description: Coordinates refinery cargo clearances and escort requests.

Name: HaicheWatch
Description: Monitors orbital approaches on behalf of the Protectorate.

Name: HaicheEnvoy
Description: Coordinates visits and regulated transits through Haiche.

Name: SilessiaWatch
Description: Handles civilian distress and shipping reports.

Name: SilessiaEnvoy
Description: Handles high-level Confederacy security coordination.

Name: MarakWatch
Description: Coordinates local transfer station patrols.

Name: MarakCommand
Description: Issues senior orders on the Hegemony command channel.

Name: GarrisonWatch
Description: Tracks freight inspections and approach clearance.

Name: LorisCommand
Description: Coordinates Hegemony fleet readiness across Loris.

Name: RenserWatch
Description: Tracks passage through Renser and reports threats to Hegemony shipping.

Name: AramWatch
Description: Oversees inbound traffic at Aram.

Name: KolchevWatch
Description: Monitors the outbound convoys from Kolchev.

Name: AdantarWatch
Description: Coordinates squadron coverage around Adantar.

Name: TarsusWatch
Description: Oversees fleet and civilian transfers at Tarsus.

Name: NergalWatch
Description: Patrol contact for the Nephrys transfer hub at Nergal.

Name: RadixCommand
Description: Coordinates fleet movements and clearance in Radix.

Name: RamekEnvoy
Description: Processes freight movements through the transfer station at Ramek.

Name: VolanteWatch
Description: Oversees Hegemony security at the Volante transfer hub.

Name: FortTalasWatch
Description: Coordinates patrols from the Dantari position at Fort Talas.

Name: JalahCell
Description: Arranges resupply through trusted traffic at Jalah.

Name: FoothillCommand
Description: Operates the restricted Dantari command link from Foothill.

Name: OstaraExpedition
Description: Alliance expeditionary liaison for assignments originating in Ostara.

Name: LorisExpedition
Description: Alliance expeditionary liaison for assignments originating in Loris.

Name: HaicheExpedition
Description: Alliance expeditionary liaison for assignments originating in Haiche.

Name: RenserExpedition
Description: Alliance expeditionary liaison for assignments originating in Renser.

Name: RadixExpedition
Description: Alliance expeditionary liaison for assignments originating in Radix.

Name: KoriusExpedition
Description: Alliance expeditionary liaison for assignments originating in Korius.

Name: MeridianFleetCommand
Description: Introduces the Solus operation from Meridian. Issues the active campaign story orders and generated fleet assignments, with campaign progression and command-rank requirements retained.

Name: BorovaFleetCommand
Description: Introduces the Borova operation and relays its story orders and generated assignments after the preceding campaign section is complete.

Name: AdonisFleetCommand
Description: Commands the Jarnell operations from Adonis. Introduces each campaign section in sequence and relays its authored story orders and generated fleet assignments.

Name: MarakanStory41
Description: A missing Alliance reconnaissance ship has brought the carrier Archon into Aram. Hegemony Command considers this an armed incursion. Screen Orten while identifying and driving off the incoming Alliance patrol. Do not pursue the carrier beyond the border picket.

Name: MarakanStory42
Description: Alliance strike package Condor is closing on the supply freighter Ascentia. Those holds sustain the Loris garrison. Break the bomber attack and keep the freighter intact; the Alliance escort is a secondary threat.

Name: MarakanStory43
Description: An Alliance strike is crossing the line above the Tantalus mining works. From the Hegemony side this is a raid on a working supply installation. Protect the station and intercept Alpha before its ordnance reaches the refinery.

Name: MarakanStory44
Description: The carrier Archon has launched Mustang against our destroyer Sidus. Keep the strike fighters off the ship while Sidus withdraws under Orinoco's screen. Hegemony command needs this force intact for the Renser defense.

Name: MarakanStory45
Description: Alliance flight Echo is attempting to suppress the defenses of Shadow Canyon. Hold the starbase perimeter, intercept the attackers and preserve the landing corridor for our returning crews.

Name: MarakanStory46
Description: Alliance cruisers Wraith and Nemesis are hunting our Paragon screen. Take command of the counterattack, protect Parthan and force the leading cruiser out of the approach lane. Neutral shipping is to be left alone.

Name: MarakanStory47
Description: Antares has committed a carrier group over Korius. Hegemony liaison command orders a fighter screen around Goliath while the allied Dantari force reorganizes. Contain the Alliance escort; the opposing carrier is not your primary target.

Name: DantariStory51
Description: Alliance forces have answered the Directorate appeal and Archon is entering the courier corridor. To the Separatist fleet this is foreign intervention. Support our blockade patrol and intercept the carrier's advancing fighter screen.

Name: DantariStory52
Description: A Directorate courier carries orders intended to consolidate the failed coup's aftermath. Stop the military dispatch before it reaches the Alliance liaison. Expect Vanguard to protect the courier.

Name: DantariStory53
Description: The Directorate is using Harmony Station to stage Alliance support. Escort Kalon Strike into the approach corridor and break the Avengers screen. Civilian berths are outside your engagement orders.

Name: DantariStory54
Description: Alliance fighters have opened a relief corridor at Trellis. Our command claims the same route is moving Directorate war supplies. Interdict the armed escort while our strike group inspects the shipping lane.

Name: DantariStory55
Description: Our Hegemony liaison reports an Alliance picket watching the Renser buildup. Cover the scouts as they recover their sensor records and disengage. This patrol is intelligence work, not an invasion of the picket line.

Name: DantariStory56
Description: The Directorate observatory at Tal Vesta is feeding tracking data to Alliance ships. Kendra and Pelorat are exposed to an approaching relief flight. Break its fighter screen and protect the Separatist ships; avoid the civilian research structures.

Name: DantariStory57
Description: Accusations over Renser have hardened both fleets. Hold a defensive cordon around the liaison interceptors while the Alliance moves Stalwart into the area. Defeat the advance fighters and preserve our evidence relay.

Name: DantariStory58
Description: The Senate resolution gives the Alliance a mandate we do not recognize. Escort our inspection group through the Trellis approach and challenge the armed escort. The relief transport itself is not a combat objective.

Name: DantariStory59
Description: The fleet is falling back to Jalah. Rear Guard must hold long enough for the scattered crews to return. Protect it from the Alliance fighter screen and keep the withdrawal route open.

Name: DantariStory60
Description: Archon and Stalwart are pressing into Khaital. The Dantari liaison flight must protect Ironhelm and Mattock while the defensive force reforms. Defeat the carrier's fighter screen without abandoning the withdrawal line.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer201
Description: A Directorate courier is trying to carry emergency orders through our allied patrol. Escort Separatist Pursuit into position and break Vanguard's escort screen. Preserve the liaison ships; do not chase the courier into civilian traffic.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer202
Description: Our scouts have detected an Alliance picket watching the Renser approaches. Protect Hegemony Scouts while their records are relayed to command. Intercept Vanguard before it can fix our withdrawal vector.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer203
Description: The accusations over Renser are bringing Stalwart forward. Our liaison interceptors must remain on station long enough to confirm the fleet movement. Screen them against Vanguard and keep a route clear for recovery.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer204
Description: Alliance fighters are escorting a transport through the Trellis cordon. Protect our inspection flight and challenge the armed escort. Relief passengers and civilian crews are outside your engagement orders.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer205
Description: The Dantari force is falling back toward Jalah. Hegemony liaison command has committed your flight to cover Separatist Rear Guard. Stop Vanguard from disrupting the withdrawal and bring our crews home.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer206
Description: Harmony Station has become an anchor for Alliance support. Escort Kalon Strike into the approach lane, defeat Avengers and preserve the strike group. Civilian berths remain protected.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer207
Description: Archon is advancing into Solus behind an Alliance fighter screen. Protect Blockade Patrol and intercept Avengers before the cordon is scattered. The carrier itself is not your flight's objective.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer208
Description: Archon and Stalwart are pressing our Khaital line. Ironhelm needs time to regroup under Mattock's cover. Break Vanguard's advance and keep the defensive group intact.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer209
Description: Kendra is exposed near the Tal Vesta observatory as Alliance relief fighters arrive. Cover the ship and defeat Vanguard. Your orders concern the armed escort, not the civilian research complex.

Name: MarakanCampaign2Officer210
Description: The Alliance has opened a passage through the Trellis approaches. Support our patrol while it reforms the cordon, and defeat Avengers before they can widen the breach. Neutral vessels are to be left clear.

Name: MarakanCampaign3Officer211
Description: The Janek forward screen is exposed while our spearhead reforms. Defend the picket, destroy the Alliance interception flight and recover before our carriers shift station. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Vanguard and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign3Officer212
Description: Borova is the hinge of the advance. Hold the approach against an Alliance counterattack while the forward wing refuels; preserve the assigned defense flight. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Pursuit and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign3Officer213
Description: Alliance scouts have located our Borova staging lane. Break the counterstroke and protect the ships forming the next sortie. Do not chase beyond the recovery corridor. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Pursuit and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign3Officer214
Description: Diplomatic traffic is crossing the contested Borova perimeter. Keep armed Alliance interceptors away from the protected liaison unit. Civilian traffic is not a target. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign3Officer215
Description: The Pallas spearhead is isolated from its escorts. Clear the Alliance fighter screen, keep the marked Hegemony unit alive and recover to the carrier. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Fighters and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign3Officer216
Description: A rear guard is buying time for the Borova withdrawal. Intercept the pursuing Alliance flights and prevent them from overrunning the protected element. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Rear Guard and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign3Officer217
Description: Our Silessia passage is threatened by Alliance reconnaissance flights. Clear the corridor while the marked unit crosses, then return rather than pursuing into another sector. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign3Officer218
Description: Brotherhood raiders are exploiting the Vesta withdrawal. Defeat the pirate screen and protect the assigned Hegemony unit. This is a recovery action, not an attack on civilian shipping. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Supply Tender and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign4Officer219
Description: Aram outpost requests immediate relief. Protect its local defense force and stop the Alliance interception flight before it can pin down the relief ships. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Outpost Patrol and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign4Officer220
Description: The ambassador route through Tarsus is compromised. Defend the liaison element against armed interceptors and keep the recovery lane clear. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Rogue Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign4Officer221
Description: Unknown Zolon craft have entered the Tarsus engagement. Prioritize the alien attackers threatening the protected unit. Do not treat this as another routine Alliance patrol. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Supply Tender and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign4Officer222
Description: Loris supply tenders are exposed during the retreat. Escort the protected tender through the marked lane and destroy Brotherhood raiders before they reach it. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Supply Tender and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign4Officer223
Description: The Kolchev picket must survive to warn the next defensive line. Defend the marked interceptors, defeat the Alliance screen and recover without sacrificing the picket. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign5Officer224
Description: Zolon probes have appeared near Garrison. Defend the Hegemony picket and destroy the alien scouts before they fix the recovery route. The Zolons are the enemy; you remain a Hegemony pilot. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Picket and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign5Officer225
Description: Zolon strike craft are crossing Radix. Protect the interceptor screen holding the junction and stop the alien attack before it cuts our withdrawal route. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign5Officer226
Description: Alien attackers are closing on Ramek. Keep the defense wing alive and the bay approach clear so damaged crews can recover. Break the Zolon attack and return to the carrier. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Ramek Defense Wing and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign5Officer227
Description: Zolon forces threaten Garrison Military Laboratory during the evacuation of its technical staff. Defend the facility and defeat the alien strike screen; no attack on neutral rescuers is authorized. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Garrison Military Laboratory and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanCampaign5Officer228
Description: The Zolon pursuit has reached Volante. Protect the Hegemony rear guard, destroy the pursuing alien flights and preserve the final recovery corridor for surviving crews. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Rear Guard and recover to your carrier.

Name: MarakanInduction
Description: Read your faction induction and report for qualified agent assignments. Original Alliance training is kept separate.

Name: DantariInduction
Description: Read your faction induction and report for qualified agent assignments. Original Alliance training is kept separate.

Name: HegemonyFlightTraining
Description: Welcome to Hegemony Flight Induction. You are assigned to the training wing aboard Manticore. Complete carrier qualifications, gunnery, atmospheric flight and ground strike before advancing to capital-ship command. Surface lessons operate from Tiger Base. Rank and command-skill gates apply.

Name: DantariFlightTraining
Description: Welcome to Separatist Flight Induction. You are assigned to the training wing aboard Goliath. Complete carrier qualifications, gunnery, atmospheric flight and ground strike before advancing to capital-ship command. Surface lessons operate from Telmera Starport. Rank and command-skill gates apply.

Name: OrionFlightOperations
Description: Issues independent flight clearances to qualified pilots. Accept Free Flight and start the assignment before requesting departure.

Name: JanekFlightOperations
Description: Issues independent flight clearances to qualified pilots. Accept Free Flight and start the assignment before requesting departure.
